readme.section: DSHM 插件 · DeepSeek Harness 远程连接
readme.text:
简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

[DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile) · **DSHM 电脑插件** · [DSHM 中转服务](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay)

**DSHM 插件**安装在电脑的官方 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中，将工作区、聊天会话、执行结果和审批同步到 [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile)。手机远程续聊与决策，电脑执行任务；无需修改或重建 DSH。

readme.section: 远程会话与设备管理功能
readme.text:
| 能力 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话同步 | 查看工作区与历史、创建聊天、发送消息、切换模型、处理审批。 |
| 设备管理 | 五分钟有效的一次性配对链接；核对指纹、批准、拒绝与撤销。 |
| 访问控制 | 开关远程连接；电脑管理权限另行授予或收回。 |
| 扩展 | 通过允许的接口转发文件、工具结果与兼容插件局部界面。 |

[图片来源](./docs/images/README.md)。真实插件页面，使用演示设备。

[插件构建与下载](./docs/releases.md) · [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/actions/workflows/plugin-build.yml) · [发行版本](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases)

**官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 共用同一 GitHub 安装包：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin
```

`dsh plugin` 是 DSH 官方命令。若你从 DSH 源码目录启动，使用 `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin`。仓库包含预编译产物，安装时不需要编译器、相邻后端目录或额外构建许可；正式使用建议复制市场提供的 `#完整提交号` 命令，固定到已扫描版本。[GitHub 安装与版本说明](./docs/github-install.md)

仓库默认安装包 `0.1.87-latest.0` 支持上述三个已验版本。alpha.1 仍需使用对应的 `.tgz`，不能使用默认命令。四个版本的插件包可从本次 Release 下载，直接下载无需登录 GitHub：

| 电脑 DSH 版本 | 直接下载 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | [rc.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.87-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz) |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | [alpha.1 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.87-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.1.tgz) |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | [0.2.1-rc.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.87-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-rc.2.tgz) |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2` | [alpha.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.87-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.2.tgz) |

核心 Remote 请使用 [DSHM 0.1.0-preview.7 APK](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0-preview.7/DSHM-0.1.0-preview.7.apk)，三版核心连接已验；alpha.1 归档保留，不代表此 App 已完成其连接验证。[rc.2 验证范围](./compatibility/latest-upstream/dsh-rc21-compatibility.md) · [完整配对步骤](./docs/usage.md)

**0.1.87** 修复长聊天响应过大，配套 preview.7；自建中转也需升级到包含协议提交 `94183d0` 的版本。旧端继续小响应通信，大响应能力需要三端配套。[分块与兼容边界](./compatibility/latest-upstream/response-chunks.md)。

1. 安装匹配 DSH 版本的插件，运行 `pnpm dsh web`；提示下次启动加载时，重启 DSH。
2. 填写中转根地址、电脑名称，注册电脑并开启连接。
3. 手机领取配对链接，电脑核对指纹并批准。
4. 手机打开已有工作区，继续会话或创建新聊天。

**推荐[自建中转](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay)**；也可填[公共服务](http://118.31.20.47:18787) `http://118.31.20.47:18787`。开放注册免密，设备仍需配对与批准，无需用户账号。

公共服务使用 HTTP，传输未加密。敏感内容建议自建 HTTPS。电脑和 DSH 必须保持运行。[完整安装步骤](./docs/usage.md)

点击插件设置页 **“修改服务地址”**：

- **同一后端换地址：** 换域名、端口或 HTTPS，验证后保留电脑身份和授权。
- **更换后端：** 重新注册和配对；个人模式需新密钥，旧服务授权不会自动撤销。

取消或验证失败保留原连接，保存成功保留启停状态。手机需新链接重新配对。[详细步骤](./docs/usage.md#5-修改服务地址)
**0.1.87-latest.0** 新增 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 核心连接适配，改用兼容范围与真实接口能力检查；需配套 App preview.6。[修复与验证边界](./compatibility/latest-upstream/dsh-rc21-compatibility.md)。

| 范围 | 版本与已验内容 |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub 安装 | `0.1.87-latest.0`，同一份预编译产物支持官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`；三版核心连接已验。[历史双版本记录](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) |
| Release 下载 | 四个 DSH 版本归档及校验信息；按文件名选择电脑版本。[构建说明](./docs/releases.md) |
| 修改服务地址 | `0.1.81-latest.0` 的[独立设置页验证](./compatibility/latest-upstream/gateway-settings.md)，不代表完整 Remote 重验。 |
| 核心 Remote | 官方 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`＋插件 `0.1.80-latest.0`＋原配套 Android，在 Web + MuMu 完成本地验收。[支持清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) |

当前为公开预发布。GitHub 安装与构建通过不等于已完成新包的全量手机兼容验收；Electron、真机、完整公网及其他版本、插件、模型需另验。

手机不创建电脑工作区、不输入命令、不转发电脑 localhost 网站。

readme.section: 应该选择哪个 DSH 版本的插件包？
readme.text: 先查看电脑的 DSH 版本。GitHub 默认安装支持 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2`；下载 `.tgz` 时，包名中的 `dsh-<版本>` 必须对应电脑版本，例如 `dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz`。alpha.1 使用自己的归档。升级 DSH 后重新核对[兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md)，不要把未验版本默认视为兼容。

readme.section: 配对链接发给手机后就能访问电脑吗？
readme.text: 还需要电脑核对手机的公钥指纹并批准。链接五分钟内有效，领取后失效；已批准设备可以在电脑插件页撤销，电脑管理权限另行授予。

readme.section: 手机续聊必须获得电脑管理权限吗？
readme.text: 不需要。批准设备后即可使用聊天与任务操作；管理电脑工作区、插件和设置需要另行授予管理权限，也可以单独收回。操作入口见[管理访问](./docs/usage.md#4-管理访问)。

TypeScript + Cordis，React 配置页。GitHub Actions 自动准备固定后端协议与已发布 SDK，分别打包三个 DSH 版本，并核对提交的 GitHub 安装产物与源码一致。`lib/` 是安装入口，`dist/` 仅作旧开发输出，见[自动构建说明](./docs/releases.md)与开发指南。

```text
src/              电脑插件、会话适配与配置页
lib/              已编译 GitHub 安装入口，随源码提交并由 CI 复核
scripts/          构建与审查脚本
tests/            插件测试与夹具

[DSHM Android app](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/blob/main/README.en.md) · **DSHM desktop plugin** · [DSHM relay server](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay/blob/main/README.en.md)

**DSHM Plugin** runs inside official [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) on your computer, synchronizing workspaces, chat sessions, execution results, and approvals with the [DSHM Android client](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/blob/main/README.en.md). Continue conversations and make decisions remotely while the computer executes tasks. No DSH core modifications or rebuilds are required.

[Install from GitHub](#install-the-plugin-and-pair-your-phone) · [Download plugin packages](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/tag/v0.1.87-latest.0) · [DSH compatibility (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) · [FAQ](#faq)

| Capability | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Conversation sync | View workspaces and history, create chats, send messages, switch models, and handle approvals. |
| Device management | Generate one-time pairing links valid for five minutes; verify fingerprints, approve, reject, or revoke devices. |
| Access control | Enable or disable remote connections. Computer management permission is granted and revoked separately. |
| Extensions | Forward files, tool results, and compatible plugin interface elements through permitted APIs. |
[Image sources (Chinese)](./docs/images/README.md). The real plugin interface uses demo devices and Simplified Chinese labels.

readme.section: Install the plugin and pair your phone
readme.text: `dsh plugin` is the official DSH command. From a DSH source checkout, use `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin`. Compiled files are included: installation requires no compiler, adjacent backend checkout, or build-script approval. Prefer the market's command pinned with `#<full-commit-sha>` for a scanned version. [GitHub installation details (Chinese)](./docs/github-install.md)

readme.section: Install the plugin and pair your phone
readme.text: The default GitHub package, `0.1.87-latest.0`, supports these three tested versions. Alpha.1 still requires its separate `.tgz`. Update the App to preview.7 and the relay to include protocol commit `94183d0` for large responses. [Chunked-response support (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/response-chunks.md). All four archives are available without a GitHub account:

readme.text: Use [DSHM 0.1.0-preview.7](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0-preview.7/DSHM-0.1.0-preview.7.apk) for the three tested core connections. Alpha.1 retains its archive without a new App connection claim. [rc.2 validation (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/dsh-rc21-compatibility.md) · [Pairing guide (Chinese)](./docs/usage.md)

readme.section: Install the plugin and pair your phone
readme.text:
1. Install a plugin build matching your DSH version and run `pnpm dsh web`. Restart DSH if it says the plugin will load on the next start.
2. Enter the relay's root URL and computer name, register the computer, and enable the connection.
3. Claim the pairing link on your phone, then verify its fingerprint and approve it on the computer.
4. Open an existing workspace on your phone to continue a conversation or start a new chat.

readme.section: Install the plugin and pair your phone
readme.text: **[Hosting your own relay](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay/blob/main/README.en.md) is recommended.** Alternatively, enter the [public service](http://118.31.20.47:18787) URL: `http://118.31.20.47:18787`. Open registration requires no enrollment token; devices still need pairing and approval. No user account is needed.

readme.section: Install the plugin and pair your phone
readme.text: The public service uses HTTP, so transport is unencrypted. Use a self-hosted HTTPS relay for sensitive content. Keep the computer and DSH running. [Full setup instructions (Chinese)](./docs/usage.md)

In the plugin settings, select **“修改服务地址” (Change server address)**:

- **New address for the same backend:** Change the domain, port, or HTTP/HTTPS scheme. After verification, the computer identity and device permissions are retained.
- **Different backend:** Register and pair again. Private mode requires the new backend's enrollment token. Permissions on the old service are not automatically revoked.

Canceling or failed verification keeps the original connection. A successful save preserves whether the connection is enabled or disabled. The phone needs a new link to pair again. [Detailed steps (Chinese)](./docs/usage.md#5-修改服务地址)

**0.1.87-latest.0** adds core connectivity for **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`**, with compatibility ranges and capability checks. Pair with App preview.6. See the [fix and validation scope (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/dsh-rc21-compatibility.md).

| Scope | Version and validated behavior |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub installation | `0.1.87-latest.0` shares one compiled package across official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`. Core connections passed; full validation remains scoped. [Evidence (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) |
| Release downloads | Four DSH-version archives and checksums; choose the filename matching your host. [Build guide (Chinese)](./docs/releases.md) |
| Relay URL changes | [Separate settings-page validation (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/gateway-settings.md) with `0.1.81-latest.0`; not a complete Remote rerun. |
| Core Remote | Official DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2` + plugin `0.1.80-latest.0` + the original matching Android app, validated locally in Web + MuMu. [Support matrix (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) |

This is a public prerelease. Successful GitHub installation or packaging does not establish full phone compatibility for a new package. Electron, physical devices, the complete public-network path, and other versions, plugins, and models need separate validation.

The phone does not create computer workspaces, accept manually entered commands, or forward computer localhost websites.

readme.section: Which plugin package matches my DSH version?
readme.text: Check computer DSH's version. The default GitHub package supports `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. For `.tgz` downloads, choose the exact matching `dsh-<version>` in the name; for example, `dshm-plugin-0.1.87-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz` targets rc.2. Alpha.1 requires its own archive. Recheck the [compatibility report (Chinese)](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) after updating DSH.

readme.section: Does claiming a pairing link immediately allow computer access?
readme.text: The computer must first verify the phone's public-key fingerprint and approve it. Links expire after five minutes and can only be claimed once. Revoke approved devices from the computer's plugin settings; computer management permission is granted separately.

readme.section: Does continuing conversations require computer management permission?
readme.text: No. Device approval allows chat and task operations. Managing computer workspaces, plugins, and settings requires separate management permission, which can also be revoked separately. See [access management (Chinese)](./docs/usage.md#4-管理访问).

lib/              Committed GitHub install files, rebuilt and checked in CI

tests/            Plugin tests and fixtures
